covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Edinburgh Waverley, Haymarket and Slateford, from the UK's national real-time feed.

partial.label: Edinburgh Trams
partial.detail: On the catalog, but no confirmed live-times feed exists at the moment — Trams stops aren't offered in the station picker or Near me for now, rather than being selectable and then showing an error. They stay on file for when a confirmed feed exists.

notCovered.label: Caledonian Sleeper
notCovered.detail: Excluded at Edinburgh Waverley — booking a berth is compulsory.

stations: 59 stations and stops: 37 National Rail stations across Edinburgh and the Lothians (13 Sep 2026 UK station fill), plus the Trams line from Newhaven to the Airport.
notes: The Trams stop named Edinburgh Waverley is a separate stop from the rail station of the same name, with no automatic interchange.
